text: Small inspection shop. Very personable folks. Fast service. I’ve had my vehicles inspected at the same place a block from these guys for over 40 years until they tried to screw me around. This shop gets my business for the next 40 years.
They were wonderful! Fast, friendly, and professional. Nice cool place to wait for my car. I won't go anywhere else.
Professional, kind and high quality service. They even do call outs if you are stuck. Highly recommend!

I went there to have my State Inspection completed to renew my registration.  I normally go to a national chain, but their machine was down.  I'm glad that happened because Veloz EZ was fast (just 15 minutes) and I just walked around and …

Great place for state inspection.  Low key place with friendly service.  In and out.
They even went above and beyond by vacuuming drivers seat.  With that type of service, I will return for my oil change as well.

What a find in the neighborhood!  Alexis is very professional with covid guidelines to make you feel safe while you get your inspection done.  My service was efficient and overall great experience.  We will definitely use again for state inspection needs.

I went to get my car inspected after I found out my recent inspection from another state wasn't valid in Texas to get my car registered. The owner was very friendly and helpful. I was in and out in 10 minutes tops. I'm so happy I found this …
If you are looking for a car detail place check out Veloz EZ Auto Care behind Bruno's Place: a self-serve dog wash in Oak Cliff does a fantastic job and at a reasonable price. …

I got my inspection and car wash here. To be honest the inspection was quick and easy, and they did an amazing job with the car wash. The people there are great! Plus it’s great to support a local business!

I went today, December 5, 2019 to get my care inspected after 4:00 P.M. I was surprised at how efficient this shop is and how quickly they finished the inspection. Jesús was very friendly and I would recommend this shop for anyone needing an inspection.

This is a small family run business that provides fast service for a good price. I came in for a state inspection and was in and out the door in 10 minutes. The business owner is friendly and pleasant to interact with.

Business changed hands first of the year.  It's even better!  Now you can get oil changes, tire service and other mechanic services such as tune-up, alternator or starter repairs as well as state inspection.
Very easy and affordable. Took me maybe 10 minutes for the whole process. Very nice people!

Fast inspection. The lady in charge was so nice and professional, love the welcoming environment.
Nice and clean waiting area.
Very friendly and efficient, with a seamless state inspection. They also have a very comfortable waiting area and accept cash or card.
No frills. Quick, easy, and relatively inexpensive. They were able to accommodate without an appointment, and they had me out in less than 10 minutes.
Friendly and quick! Highly recommend! I went for a state inspection and will now always go here.
We have had two cars inspected here by Alexis.  He and his company demonstrate exemplary customer service, quality work and generate a positive and pleasant experience.
Wait time was short and they did the work quickly and efficiently. They definitely have my ongoing business.
Awesome place. Nice lady that did my inspection and no wait. She even vacuumed my car while I was waiting.
People was very nice and they got everything done in short time I really recommend everyone to check this place.
Such a hidden gem! Lovely family and great service. I will definitely be returning!
Great local company. Went in and out without an appointment. Strongly recommend!
The first mechanic owner of this place , was the best and does anyone know if he is still in oak cliff. I Can't find him anywhere.
The service was fast and incredibly friendly. They are courteous to fan with seats and air.
Good customer service. Very nice people and very fast service.  Excellent service.
I really appreciate how quick and efficient my fist was. Plus it is close to the tax office to get registered. It was very convenient and I appreciate the help!
No wait for an inspection on a Saturday afternoon. Friendly service and a convenient location. Highly recommend!

I went here for a state inspection. There wasn’t any line, it was clean, they were super friendly (they even offered me water and an ice cream bar), and they were done and I was on my way in about 15 min. Couldn’t ask for more or better!
This place is the best, I come here every year!
Super quick and easy. Will be coming her for all my future inspection needs on all vehicles.
Amazing
Very quick vehicle admission test without appointment
everyone was so kind and it was the quickest inspection I’ve ever had! Thank you!

Great experience, went for a deep clean
